import re, math

# Build selected files per month: prefer .txt over .pdf
from collections import defaultdict

access_token = access_token  # keep

year = datetime.now().year

# list all electricity files for the year
el_year_files = [p for p in listing if '/bills/electricity/' in p and p.split('/')[-1].startswith(f'{year}-')]

# Map month -> chosen path
month_to_files = defaultdict(list)
for p in el_year_files:
    fname = p.split('/')[-1]
    m = re.search(rf'^{year}-(\d\d)', fname)
    if m:
        month = int(m.group(1))
        month_to_files[month].append(p)

for month in sorted(month_to_files):
    print('month', month, 'files', sorted(month_to_files[month]))

selected_paths=[]
for month, files in month_to_files.items():
    txts=[f for f in files if f.endswith('.txt')]
    if txts:
        selected=sorted(txts)[0]
    else:
        selected=sorted([f for f in files if f.endswith('.pdf')])[0]
    selected_paths.append((month, selected))

selected_paths_sorted = sorted(selected_paths, key=lambda x:x[0])
print('selected_paths_sorted', selected_paths_sorted)
print('selected_count', len(selected_paths_sorted))
